name: martebizuteria
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform for M'Arte Jewellery. High-performance storefront & admin dashboard built with TanStack Start and React. Luxury UX via GSAP & Lenis. Styled with Tailwind & Shadcn UI. Powered by Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, and KV. Internationalized with use-intl.

scripts.build:preview: rm -rf dist && bun run content && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview vp build --mode preview && bun scripts/verify-build.ts preview
scripts.build:production: rm -rf dist && bun run content && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production vp build --mode production && bun scripts/verify-build.ts production
scripts.build:test: rm -rf dist && bun run content && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=test vp build --mode test
scripts.cf-typegen: vp exec wrangler types --env development src/types/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.clean: rm -rf .source .output .tanstack .wrangler .bun-cache dist dist-ssr coverage playwright-report test-results blob-report playwright/.cache playwright/.auth *.tsbuildinfo src/types/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.clean:hardcore: bun run clean:deep && rm -rf bun.lock opensrc
scripts.db:migrate:development: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env development --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env development --local
scripts.db:migrate:preview: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:migrate:test: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env test --local --persist-to .wrangler/test
scripts.db:migrations:development: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations list DB --env development --remote
scripts.db:migrations:preview: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations list DB --env preview --remote
scripts.db:migrations:production: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations list DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:reset:test: rm -rf .wrangler/test && bun run db:migrate:test && bun run db:seed:test
scripts.db:seed:preview: vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/delivery-methods.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-categories.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-collections.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-attributes.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/products.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-variants.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/inventory.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-images.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/category-on-product.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/collection-on-product.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/attribute-on-product.sql
scripts.db:seed:production: vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/delivery-methods.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-categories.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-collections.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-attributes.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/products.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-variants.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/inventory.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/product-images.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/category-on-product.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/collection-on-product.sql && vp exec wrangler d1 execute DB --env production --remote --file=src/integrations/drizzle-orm/seeds/attribute-on-product.sql
scripts.deploy:preview: bun scripts/verify-bindings.ts preview && bun run build:preview && bun scripts/prepare-deploy-secrets.ts preview && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV vp exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --secrets-file .wrangler/secrets.preview.json
scripts.deploy:production: bun scripts/verify-bindings.ts production && bun run build:production && bun scripts/prepare-deploy-secrets.ts production && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV vp exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --secrets-file .wrangler/secrets.production.json
scripts.dev: bun run content && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=development vp dev --mode development
scripts.skills:update: bunx --bun skills update --project --yes && bun run skills:sync
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.typegen: bun run cf-typegen && bun run content
